verdict.rationale: Docs confirm reranking ('Advanced Retrieval' reorders results semantically) and entity-scoped filtering by user/agent/app/session, giving developers some control beyond plain similarity search, but there is no documented keyword or hybrid (lexical+vector) search mode, and metadata filtering is limited to fixed entity scopes rather than arbitrary metadata fields. missing for 10: explicit keyword/hybrid search mode, general arbitrary metadata filter API, independent benchmarking of retrieval quality.
